page_title: NEW 2-0 CHE | Newcastle v Chelsea 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' John Brooks is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+4' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Bruno Guimaraes and he is replaced by Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd).
90+4' Here comes a substitution. Alexander Isak is given a rest as he is replaced by Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd).
90+3' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 2 - 0 Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) smashes the ball into the top right corner of the goal to give the goalkeeper absolutely no chance of making a save!
89' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
88' Reece James (Chelsea) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.
85' John Brooks shows the yellow card to Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) for a heavy challenge.
83' Reece James (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

83' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the top right corner of the net. The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' John Brooks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) brought his opponent down.
80' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) races onto a pass and smashes in a shot at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.
80' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) takes the corner but it's cleared.
75' Enzo Maresca has decided to make a change. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) replaces Romeo Lavia.
75' Substitution. Trevoh Chalobah walks off the pitch and Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) comes on as a substitute.
74' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
72' John Brooks blows his whistle and it's Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
71' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
70' The attendance is 52231.
70' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
69' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Chelsea as they win a corner.
65' Here comes a substitution. Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Anthony Gordon.
64' The referee John Brooks awards Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) a yellow card.

62' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom right corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
59' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
58' Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
55' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) replacing Sven Botman.
53' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
50' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
48' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) picks up an injury.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Enzo Maresca probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Noni Madueke. He is replaced by Reece James (Chelsea).
46' Referee John Brooks blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) kept talking out of turn to the referee until John Brooks lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
45+5' A corner kick by Chelsea is thwarted by the well prepared Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd).
45+4' A great run by Pedro Neto (Chelsea) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. Chelsea get a corner.
45+1' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

44' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Robert Sanchez, who pulls off a comfortable save!
44' It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.
43' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) inside the box. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Enzo Maresca appears to have said too much and referee John Brooks comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
39' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
35' RED card! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

34' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), but referee John Brooks must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
33' Yellow card! It's like Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. John Brooks agrees and books him.
31' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nick Pope, who smothers the ball.
30' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and John Brooks blows for a foul.
27' The shot by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Robert Sanchez.
25' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
25' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
24' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
24' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Chelsea earn a corner.
23' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
21' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
20' A toe poke from Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) heads right for the middle of the goal, but Robert Sanchez is well placed and makes a good save.
18' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
16' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
14' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
13' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
12' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
10' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
9' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' Chelsea seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Looks like Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
2' 1 - 0 What an excellent finish! Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and slotted the ball ino the middle of the net. Unstoppable shot!
2' The resulting corner from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) comes to nothing.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be John Brooks.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
